resources.string: Records taps, text changes (password values are never recorded), scrolls and screen changes for test automation. Data is only readable over ADB by the local Recorder Agent. Use on test devices with synthetic data only.

AI Mobile Test Studio Companion

Enable the "AI Mobile Test Studio Recorder" accessibility service to let the local Recorder Agent capture UI interactions over ADB.

Test devices and synthetic data only. Disable the service when not recording.
